text:
maria: Heads up — we've been getting a spike of 'kms-key-usage-suspicious' alerts from the SIEM starting ~02:40 UTC, ~5/day this morning. They all correlate to the nightly key-rotation job. Might be false positives.
ajay: saw that, thanks. Is rotation using the service account `infra-key-rotator@redwood`? If so, rule should exclude that principal or add a UID filter.
sam_ops: confirmed. rotation uses that SA and hits KMS via private network. The audit event looks like:
```json
{\"event\": \"Decrypt\", \"principal\": \"serviceAccount:infra-key-rotator@redwood\", \"key\": \"projects/foo/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/rdw-main\"}
```
linh: We should not just whitelist — prefer tuning the rule: require unexpected source IP or concurrent non-rotation operations. Add a 10m rate threshold for that principal.
maria: Agreed. Proposed change: KMS alert only when principal != infra-key-rotator AND (unusual_source OR failed_auth_count > 3) OR when same key used by >2 principals in 1h.
ajay: here's a Splunk-ish filter tweak I tested:
```splunk
index=kms_audit event=Access earliest=-1h
| where principal!="serviceAccount:infra-key-rotator@redwood"
| stats count by key, principal
| where count>5
```
linh: can we instead add metadata to events so we can identify scheduled jobs (`job_id`), then filter by job_id? avoids fragile principal names.
sam_ops: rotation job can add `metadata.job=key-rotation` to logs; ops can push that. I'll file infra ticket.
maria: OK action items: 1) sam_ops to add job metadata and list affected job_ids (ETA today) 2) ajay to update SIEM rule with a suppression window and principal exclusion (ETA 3h) 3) linh to add dashboard filters and a signal/noise delta chart (ETA EOD)
pagerduty-bot: @oncall incident created INC-20274 — SIEM alert surge, acknowledged.
ajay: I'll also add runbook link and preserve a sample of 20 events for postmortem. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-siem
linh: On dashboards — add a quick filter for `job:key-rotation` and a stacked area of noisy alerts vs true positives.
maria: We'll reconvene after changes. If noise drops by 90% we close the ticket, else escalate to vuln-triage. :thumbsup:
sam_ops: infra ticket RED-445 created: add job metadata to KMS agent. Link: https://issues.redwood/RED-445
ajay: PR opened for rule: https://git.internal/rules/256 — testing in dev-siem cluster.
linh: noted, will update monitoring alert to ignore that tag for 24h post-deploy to avoid churn.
maria: thanks team — great quick loop. Postmortem draft if needed, I'll start skeleton in 24h.
sec-bot: reminder — don't hard-whitelist principals. Use contextual filters and audit enrichment.
